Delivery policy

SSV courses are digital. This policy explains how and when you get access after paying.

Privacy policyTerms of useRefund policyDelivery policy

Digital courses and notes

Paid courses and notes unlock in the SSV app on the account you paid from, normally as soon as the payment succeeds. If access has not appeared within 24 hours, contact us and we will sort it out. You also receive a payment confirmation from Razorpay.

SSV class codes

Content unlocked with an SSV class code is available as soon as the code is redeemed in the app.

Printed material

Where a classroom course includes printed study material, students collect it at the SSV centre. Any courier delivery to a remote student is dispatched within 3 to 5 working days and usually arrives within 5 to 7 working days, depending on the PIN code. Shipping is included in the fee unless a separate charge is shown before you pay.

Problems with delivery

Email contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org. We reply on working days.

Shree Siddhivinayak Classes

Physics, Chemistry and Maths for Standards 11 and 12, for GSEB boards, GUJCET and NEET. The SSV app is coming soon to Android and iPhone.
